printed: Genetics Genes and chromosomes The International Committee on Standardizing Human Gene No-menclature has developed a system knownas the International System. for Human Gene Nomenclature, but this is not universally accepted. Human genes are generally denoted by italicized symbols composed of capital letters, sometimes with the addition of an arabic numeral (e.g. CF, G6PD). Lower-case letters are commonly still used in blood-group symbols (e.g. Fy, Rh). Phenotype symbols are set in roman type (e.g. ADA 1).
